label: alg:confinement-tower-chamber-gs
title: Five-Layer Confinement-Tower Promotion and Physical Cluster-Chamber Reduction ($\mathcal{L}_0\to\mathcal{L}_4$)
html:
Prior-art reduction. Toric integer-programming test sets and Gröbner/Graver binomial reductions over \ker A_k \cap \mathbb{Z}^m follow Bruno Buchberger [buchberger2006], Jack E. Graver [graver1975], Pasqualina Conti and Carlo Traverso [conti-traverso1991], and Bernd Sturmfels and Rekha R. Thomas [sturmfels-thomas1997]; master-problem column promotion and convex electronegativity equalization follow George B. Dantzig and Philip Wolfe [dantzig-wolfe1960], Robert S. Mulliken [mulliken1934], and Robert G. Parr and Ralph G. Pearson [parr-pearson1983] (Physical cluster chamber, Iterated confinement layer).

  • Input: Conserved charge vector b_k \in \mathbb{Z}^{d_k} at layer \mathcal{L}_k \in \{\mathcal{L}_0, \dots, \mathcal{L}_4\} (baryon/charge (Z,N) at \mathcal{L}_2, electron count N_e at \mathcal{L}_3, elemental atom vector at \mathcal{L}_4) and layer cost vector c_k \in K^{m_k} over a linearly ordered ring K.
  • Output: Normal-form motif occupancy u_k^\ast \in \mathbb{N}^{m_k} satisfying A_k u_k^\ast = b_k, active promoted columns \mathcal{P}_{k\to k+1} = \{j : \bar{c}_k(e_j; y_k^\ast) < 0\}, and reduced-cost optimality certificate.
  • QOU delta (five-layer confinement tower and 11-rule physical cluster chamber): Functorial column promotion A_{k+1} = A_k M_{k\to k+1} preserves charge conservation across five coupled strata:
    1. \mathcal{L}_0 \to \mathcal{L}_1 (hadronic): projects three-strand motifs onto TL_3(q_0) (Confinement-layer operator selection, keeping intranucleon gluon stabilization open across the candidate arms);
    2. \mathcal{L}_1 \to \mathcal{L}_2 (nuclear cluster and shell): reduces light-cluster counts (p, n, d, t, h, \alpha) \in \mathbb{N}^6 modulo the 11-rule oriented binomial Gröbner basis \mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{phys}} \subset \ker A_0 whenever (B_d, B_t, B_h, B_\alpha) lies in the physical binding chamber (2B_d < B_t < B_\alpha, B_d + B_t < B_\alpha, B_d + B_h < B_\alpha, driving drip-line configurations such as {}^5\mathrm{He} \mapsto \alpha + n while isolating the endothermic 2\alpha \leftrightarrow {}^8\mathrm{Be} Hoyle bottleneck), then fills capacitated Mayer--Jensen spin--orbit shells with cumulative closures \{2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126\};
    3. \mathcal{L}_2 \to \mathcal{L}_3 \to \mathcal{L}_4 (atomic and molecular): solves discrete Mulliken--Parr--Pearson quadratic shell filling E_i(n_i) = -\chi_i n_i + \eta_i n_i^2 (\eta_i > 0) by greedy marginal-threshold steps and reduces covalent reaction networks modulo binomials in the elemental stoichiometry kernel \ker S_{\mathrm{elem}}.
  • Complexity and precision: Terminating integer-vector rewrites in \mathcal{O}(\|b_k\|_1 \cdot |\mathcal{G}_k|) exact operations; real reduced costs evaluated at 80 decimal places.
